Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Umpires are on their way in the field. USA Under-19 fielders are scattered in their position. Jordan Neill and Ryan Hunter are making their way in the middle as the openers of the Ireland Under-19. Arya Garg will be blowing the first over.
.. THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, USA Under-19 have put on an under-par score on the board, and they will have to bowl their hearts out to defend this one. Ireland Under-19 will be confident of chasing this one down and start their campaign with a crucial victory. However, we have seen funny things happen in cricket and we cannot write anyone off until the end. Join us in a bit for the second essay.

Reuben Wilson, one of the top bowlers for the Ireland Under-19  in this game is up for a chat. He says he enjoyed bowling as they started well and got the early wickets as they planned, Tells that they gave away too many extras which they have to work on, but he is happy with the overall effort of his team for restricting the opposition to a low total. He continues that he was bowling the line and lengths as he practiced earlier and it paid off in the match. He also says that Olly Riley is his best friend and they both complement each other and push their limits. He is confident enough that their batters can knock this off and this chase would be easy for them.

On the other hand, it was a lackluster batting performance from the USA Under-19. No one from their batting team was able to stand up against the Irish spells. They lost both of their openers in the Powerplay and after that, they lost their wickets at regular intervals. The lower middle-order batters tried to put up a partnership but couldn't hold it off for much longer. Khush Bhalala was the only player who scored 22 runs which is the highest in his team. Now the whole pressure is on the bowlers, as they need to make early inroads and keep picking up wickets to make a game out of this one.

Ireland Under-19 have proved why they opted to bowl after winning the toss as they managed to bowl out the USA Under-19 for just 105 runs. Reuben Wilson and Olly Riley managed to knock out the openers in the Powerplay which certainly put the Americans under pressure. They swung the ball left and right and made the opposition's batter uncomfortable. Special credits to Philippus le Roux as he was making good moves and making the right decisions of mixing the spinners and pacers at the right time to maintain the flow of wickets. Their opening pace duo were incredible throughout the game and they picked three wickets each. John McNally got a couple as well while Carson McCullough chipped in with one. They were pretty decent in the field too, but they dropped a few chances, or else they could have chasing something under a 100 here. The job looks a simple one for the Irish batters, but nothing can be predetermined in the game of cricket.

A dominating bowling display from Ireland Under-19! This is also the lowest total for USA Under-19 at this level, and they will be disappointed with how things turned out here. Not the return they were hoping for after 14 years in the ICC U-19 World Cup, but they will have to keep their chins up and put up a fight with the ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Scott Macbeth gets a wicket to finish things off here! He floats this one up, full and on off, turns away, Arya Garg takes a big stride forward to loft it over extra covers, but fails to get the timing right and slices it up in the air, Carson McCullough from cover-point runs to his left, keeps his eyes on the ball and pouches it safely. USA Under-19 have been bowled out for 105!

PITCH REPORT - Edward Rainsford is pitchside. He says that there are a few clouds around but the chances of rain are less. Adds that one square boundary is much bigger than the other, and the teams will need to bowl smartly to protect the shorter one. Tells that the pitch has grass on it with a few cracks and there will be variable bounc. Says that the the pacers will get some help upfront and the teams will look to take advantage of that.

Rishi Ramesh, the captain of USA Under-19 says they would have opted ball too as the wicket has a bit of moisture on it.  He continues that his team is very happy to take part in this contest as they have been looking after it since their childhood. He reckons that they have a good batting lineup so they will be posing a good total on the board for their opposition.

Philippus le Roux, the skipper of Ireland Under-19 says that they will bowl first as they want to start on top and put the opposition under pressure He continues they are playing pretty well lately and is happy to take on whatever's on their way.

On the other hand, USA Under-19 will be playing in the World Cup for the first time since 2010. The last time they faced the Irish team was back in January 2010 where they unfortunately lost.
